## REWORK round 1, item 2 (added) · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o` · 2026-10-16T12:29Z

CI on head `626ad92` is red in `Build & E2E` (job `116970801364`), so `Bundle Analysis` measured nothing. It is this PR's failure; the same check is green on `main`.

- **What fails:** `apps/console` `vite build` lists every asset and reports "built", then prints `undefined` and exits 1. The asset list has no `fields-date-picker-*` chunk, so a post-build check in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` most likely fails. The `fields-date-picker` chunk group and its carve-out in `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` were declared for the picker as a form-only `import()`.
- **What happens next:** the same cloud session reproduces the console build, fixes the root cause, and pushes in this round. It must not relax or delete a check or widen a ceiling. The two files above join the surface for this item only, if the right fix is the chunk declaration.

`Live E2E (informational)` on the same head is the base-red npm crash tracked in objectui#12649 (see PR #12656 comment `6214488000`).
